description: This Java source file defines the ShareProductToGLAccountMappingHelper class, which extends ProductToGLAccountMappingHelper, providing methods to manage mappings between share products and GL accounts, including saving, updating, merging, and deleting account mappings specific to share products within the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: ShareProductToGLAccountMappingHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing the mapping between share products and GL accounts, including saving, merging, updating, and deleting such mappings, tailored for the 'SHARES' product type within the accounting module.

methods.name: saveSharesToAssetAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves the account mapping for share products to the asset account.

methods.name: saveSharesToIncomeAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves the account mapping for share products to the income account.

methods.name: saveSharesToEquityAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves the account mapping for share products to the equity account.

methods.name: saveSharesToLiabilityAccountMapping
methods.description: Saves the account mapping for share products to the liability account.

methods.name: mergeSharesToAssetAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the asset account mapping for share products.

methods.name: mergeSharesToIncomeAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the income account mapping for share products.

methods.name: mergeSharesToEquityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the equity account mapping for share products.

methods.name: mergeSharesToLiabilityAccountMappingChanges
methods.description: Merges changes to the liability account mapping for share products.

methods.name: savePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Saves payment channel to fund source mappings for share products.

methods.name: updatePaymentChannelToFundSourceMappings
methods.description: Updates payment channel to fund source mappings for share products.

methods.name: saveChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Saves charge-related income account mappings for share products.

methods.name: updateChargesToIncomeAccountMappings
methods.description: Updates charge-related income account mappings for share products.

methods.name: populateChangesForNewSharesProductToGLAccountMappingCreation
methods.description: Populates the set of changes needed for creating new share product to GL account mappings based on the accounting rule.

methods.name: handleChangesToSharesProductToGLAccountMappings
methods.description: Handles and applies changes to the share product GL account mappings based on the specified accounting rule.

methods.name: deleteSharesProductToGLAccountMapping
methods.description: Deletes the GL account mapping for a specified share product.
